name: Reproductive Suppressant Gene Lock
description: Introduces a genetic switch that completely suppresses reproductive cell production until deliberately reversed with a specific chemical trigger. The modification provides 100% effective contraception without hormonal side effects — it doesn't alter hormone levels, libido, or secondary sexual characteristics. It simply stops the production of viable reproductive cells at the genetic level. The reversal trigger is a specific peptide compound that reactivates cell production within 2–3 weeks. The modification has become the standard contraception method in GLMZ, replacing pharmaceutical and mechanical alternatives almost entirely. Lacuna Genomics provides it at subsidized rates across all tiers. The reversal compound costs Φ500 and is available by prescription. Critics note that making fertility reversal dependent on a purchasable compound gives Lacuna Genomics effective control over the city's reproductive decisions.
source_organism: Synthetic gene switch construct (no organism source)
reversibility: Fully reversible with proprietary peptide trigger compound (Φ500 per reversal)
side_effects: No physiological side effects — the modification is remarkably clean
Psychological effects of externalizing fertility control to a corporate product
Dependency on Lacuna Genomics for reversal compound — supply disruption means demographic disruption
Rare: incomplete suppression requiring second dose
social_perception: Universal and unremarkable — it's the default. Not having Gene Gate is more notable than having it. The modification is so common that the ethical concerns about corporate control over fertility are background noise rather than active outrage. When a Lacuna Genomics supply shortage occurs, the outrage surfaces immediately.
story_hooks: A Lacuna Genomics supply shortage of the reversal compound creates a fertility crisis in the Shelf — people who want children can't have them, and the shortage may not be accidental
Someone begins distributing bootleg reversal compound that works but introduces unauthorized modifications into any resulting children — a quiet eugenic intervention disguised as market competition
